title: 2018 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest, University of Houston campus 2017-02-16: CASI 48-band hyperspectral (1 m), Optech Titan multispectral LiDAR (C1/C2/C3), 5 cm RGB, 20-class ground truth
licence: CC BY 4.0 (IEEE DataPort Open Access; uploads are CC BY under the DataPort Terms of Service)
attribution: 2018 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest data courtesy of the Hyperspectral Image Analysis Laboratory and NCALM, University of Houston, and the IEEE GRSS IADF TC (Prasad, Le Saux, Yokoya, Hänsch). IEEE DataPort, doi:10.21227/jnh9-nz89
profile: Archive kept whole; extracted subset: full HSI cube, training/test GT rasters, DSM_C12 and DEM_C123_3msr rasters, RGB tile 272652_3289689, LiDAR tiles C1 and C123 272652_3289689
notes: Downloaded through the owner's IEEE DataPort session (signed S3 URLs), 2026-10-27. Archive is ZIP64 (19.3 GB uncompressed); Info-ZIP unzip on Windows cannot read it, Python zipfile can. Marketing candidate for the hyperspectral and LiDAR screenshots (CC BY, attribution required).

title: 2019 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest Track 2 validation: epipolar-rectified WorldView-3 stereo pairs (RGB + 8-band MSI) with homographies and NITF metadata, Jacksonville/Omaha
licence: CC BY 4.0 (IEEE DataPort Open Access; uploads are CC BY under the DataPort Terms of Service); the WorldView-3 imagery is Maxar/DigitalGlobe commercial imagery released for the contest: test use only, never on the website
attribution: 2019 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest (IEEE GRSS IADF TC, JHU/APL, IARPA). IEEE DataPort, doi:10.21227/c6tm-vw12
profile: Archive kept whole; one tile set (JAX_163_001_006) extracted
notes: No disparity/DSM truth in the validation archive. S-14 against a reference needs 'Track 2 / Training data / Reference' (1.68 GB) plus a training image archive (smallest 3.42 GB): not downloaded, over the per-item cap.

title: Real quantized-mesh terrain tiles (241 tiles, zoom 8-12) from the HERE quantized-mesh-viewer examples
attribution: HERE Europe B.V., quantized-mesh-viewer, MIT licence
notes: Real tiles, but tin-terrain output in a Web Mercator scheme (tile header centres are not geocentric for EPSG:4326 TMS); the app reads EPSG:4326 layers only, so these do not exercise 3d.qmesh yet (IMP). The real-quantized-mesh gap stays open.

title: SICD/SIDD NITF chips from the AWS OSML imagery toolkit tests: Capella SICD 1.2.1 and 1.3.0, Umbra SICD 1.2.1, Umbra SIDD 2.0, PFA example
attribution: Amazon.com, Inc., OversightML Imagery Toolkit test data, Apache-2.0
notes: Adds Capella SICD 1.3.0 and a second vendor's chips. Does not close the quad-pol (sar.pauli) gap.

title: STANAG 4607 test packets from trane293/stanag4607: mission, dwell, HRR, platform location, free text, processing history, reserved/extension segments
notes: Synthetic but written by an independent encoder, so it cross-checks the reader against FX-11. Still no real radar GMTI.

title: BAMBI raw nadir/oblique UAV flights 258, 306, 316 (DJI M30T, Austria): wide/RGB and thermal H.264 video with per-frame SRT telemetry, Airdata flight logs and lens calibration; app-ready MPEG-TS + platform CSV derived
attribution: BAMBI project (Biodiversity Airborne Monitoring Based on Intelligent UAV sampling), https://www.bambi.eco/, CC BY 4.0
format: MPEG-TS (H.264, remuxed) + platform metadata CSV; source MP4 + DJI SRT
profile: derived/<flight>/*.ts are lossless -c copy remuxes; *.csv are the app's fmv.csv import built by build/campaign/bambi_to_fmv.py
notes: Real drone video with real telemetry, no embedded KLV (the app's platform-CSV path). Flight 316's SRT reports gimbal pitch 0 throughout although the camera looks down ~15-20 deg (source metadata, not an app issue). Records: flight_258 18983480, flight_306 19047570, flight_316 19056538.

title: USGS 3DEP Entwine Point Tile service, CO_DRCOG_1_2020 (Denver region)
